from datetime import datetime

def get_time_until_lunch():
    # Get current time
    current_time = datetime.now()
    current_time_formatted = current_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

    # Define lunch time
    lunch_time = '2024-05-15 12:30:00'

    # Calculate time until lunch
    time_until_lunch = datetime.strptime(lunch_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - current_time

    # Format time until lunch as HH:MM
    hours, remainder = divmod(time_until_lunch.seconds, 3600)
    minutes, _ = divmod(remainder, 60)
    time_until_lunch_formatted = "{:02d}:{:02d}".format(int(hours), int(minutes))

    return time_until_lunch_formatted

time_until_lunch = get_time_until_lunch()
print("Time until lunch:", time_until_lunch)
